attributes.title: Wild West Vet 2027
attributes.summary:
Wild West Vet 2027 is scheduled for October 13 to 16, 2027, at the Peppermill Resort Spa Casino in Reno, Nevada. It is aimed at veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice owners and managers, students and other animal health professionals.

The organizer says attendees can earn up to 36 CE credits, pending RACE approval that it expects before the event. Prices rise in four steps by booking date: the conference pass costs $350 until February 28, 2027 and $575 in the last window to October 12; the technician pass runs $300 to $475, a one-day pass $199 to $349, and the student pass is always $99.
